futuram.classes.matter

matter.py

This module contains classes for representing matter.

Classes: - Matter: A superclass that represents matter. - Element: A subclass that represents an element. - Compound: A subclass that represents a compound. - Material: A subclass that represents a material made up of multiple composition. - Component: A subclass that represents a component of a material. - Product: A subclass that represents a product.

Dependencies: - periodictable - pandas - json - re - ../visualisation/make_matter_treemap.py
